description.en: Requests a movie: it queues a change to a "Movie" child scene (task Ie4MovieTask) with the movie name, its sound, three fade switches and two fade lengths. "<LG>" in the sound name is replaced by the game's language code. The movie plays once the calling script suspends; wait for it with CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE. Use the PlayMovie helper.
Stored as BGMFade. PlayMovie always passes it.
Stored as FrameBeginFade (fade length at the start, in frames). PlayMovie always passes it.
Stored as FrameEndFade (fade length at the end). PlayMovie always passes it.

true once queued.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 4 arguments are given.
